column2: That particle cannon! If we don't do something about it, we're in trouble...!
I'll teleport behind the particle cannon!
No, Mitsurugi-san! That's way too dangerous!
You wanna get in our way!?
You're the ones in MY way!
I'll lend you a hand. In exchange... help me find Maria.
By the way, who are YOU?
We want to get to the off-limits area, but...
Go through Science City's underground waterway and you'll come out in the off-limits area.
The underground waterway, huh...\n\nNaturally, Rei Uryu must know about the waterway too...
This way...! I sense something in this direction!
How can you tell something like that?
Shusha-kun is evolving as a psychic!
Right now, let's hurry and find the basement! Someone has to be in there!
This looks like... the basement door.\n\n...No good, it won't open. Let's check somewhere else.
The world's largest research facility has become the world's most savage battlefield...
The off-limits area? I think it's over that way. Science City's so big, I don't really know my way around...
Even if this battle destroys the world... I shall continue my research! For the sake of the world...!
What's that? I ought to run? Excuse me, kindly don't disturb my research!
So the Uryu Conglomerate was the sponsor! Come to think of it, I may have seen Rei Uryu around a lot!?
It's kind of noisy...? Eh? A battle!? Hmm... This could make for research on human psychology in emergencies...
There sure are a lot of thugs around...? Don't you kids grow up to be grown-ups like that!
There are plenty of good doctors, but with this many wounded, there's nothing we can do!
Why is there fighting in Science City...!?
When these research results are published, the whole world will be stunned! What!? A battle in Science City...!? What a shock!!
I'm happiest when I'm doing research, but you gotta be alive to enjoy it!
Instrument readings normal!\n\nBut should I really be doing this right now?
It's noisy outside. I wonder if something happened? Whaaat! A battle!?
Look at this! The new equipment is in pieces...!
He vanished!? We've got to go after Shusha-kun...!
There's a building nearby I can't see into... Something's blocking my psychic power...
Uryu...! Wha...!? Yukishiro-san! Why are you here...!?
Ahahahahahaha! I'll tell you, Shingo Shusha! That girl has no choice but to obey my orders!
I took over the company her father runs! If she doesn't obey my orders, her whole family will have no choice but to kill themselves together!
I saw your psychic talent long ago, before I ever met you.\n\nSo I had Yukishiro transfer to your school and get close to you.
It was all a plan to get your power. And the girl did her job nicely, just as planned!
I ordered her to pretend she was in love with you. Though I never expected her to fall for you for real.
Yukishiro-san...\n\nDid you know about Uryu's plan when the Immortal Corps attacked you?
It's a lie, right? Tell me it's a lie, Yukishiro-san...!!
The girl really did fall for you. But even so, there was nothing she could do about it! She has no choice but to obey my orders!
I sense "Ma"...\n\nUgly hearts, frightening hearts, twisted hearts... a mass of evil hearts. That is Ma!
Ma brings destruction, slaughter and sorrow to this world!
The air... is filled with rage and sorrow, and hatred...! Ah...!
Mitsurugi-san!? Don't tell me something's happening to Shusha-kun...!?
He's transforming! Fuhahahaha! Shusha is transforming!
Fuhahaha! The giant of hatred! Behold the coming of the giant of rage and hatred!
We're too late...!\n\nWhen Shusha-kun's heart fills with rage and he loses his grip on reason, he draws in endless "Ma" energy, and the evil god Susano-oh is born!
